name: Underline
source:
Back in the day when high schoolers didn’t have cell phones he was one of those kids who fell behind in the academic race and wasted their teenage years.
He could hold his own in a fight, but couldn’t even hold hands with a girl.
One day, in an abandoned building, he ran into a strange high school girl.

“I’ve been waiting for you.”

From that moment, his boring life fell apart, and he gained something worth fighting for.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170102174521/http://www12.plala.or.jp/zeek-heil/UL.htm]the official website[/url]]
